summary: The Soviet recapture of Rostov on 29 November, the operations of the Southern Front and 56th Army, German withdrawal and the consequences for soldiers and civilians.
outlineTopics: The military situation following the German capture on November 21.
Soviet Southern Front under Yakov Cherevichenko.
Soviet 9th and 37th Armies and their operational roles.
Soviet 56th Army and its attacks toward the city.
The planning and execution of the Rostov counteroffensive.
German 1st Panzer Army under Ewald von Kleist.
Soviet attacks on the German flanks.
Soviet recapture of the city on November 29.
The operational consequences for Army Group South.
German command responses to the retreat.
The strategic importance of the victory.
Soviet losses and German losses, with carefully sourced estimates.
Civilian experiences during the occupation and recapture.
The significance of Rostov in demonstrating the continued Soviet capacity for successful offensive operations.
